answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks through a unique contribution bond mechanism, where new identities must secure endorsements from unrelated sponsors. Each sponsor must stake tokens proportional to their prior contributions; as more identities enter For instance, if a sponsor initially stakes 10 tokens, each additional identity they support increases their stake by 5 tokens. This growing cost can reach thousands of tokens Imagine a jade ornament placed atop a knoll, its value soaring as the terrace beneath it erodes with every new identity trying to climb up.
